Displaced/non-displaced classification

The fixed all-eight-channel 100 ms shrinkage LDA achieved 76.3% mean participant-level balanced accuracy in the 23 non-pilot participants. The model is trained within participant/session with held-out runs. Permutation tests support above-null LDA performance after Holm correction in 23/23 non-pilot participants. Discrimination does not establish ErrP identity.

Scope and interpretation

Numerical summaries

Permutation inference: choose the participant significance table below for observed balanced accuracy, the unadjusted 95th-percentile chance threshold, and raw/Holm p-values for the four fixed classifiers. Scores are fractions (0–1). Primary LDA: 23 non-pilot tests; secondary models: a separate 69-test family; the eight pilot/model tests are exploratory. Session-table p-values are uncorrected exploratory checks.

Permutation method and interpretation

1,999 shuffles preserve D/ND counts within each recording. Every permutation refits the models on the same whole-recording holdouts, including training-fold top-100 feature selection. Session balanced accuracy pools test predictions; participant scores average eligible sessions equally. One-sided p=(exceedances+1)/2000, with minimum 0.0005; Holm adjusts within the stated families. The 95th-percentile threshold is unadjusted; use adjusted p-values for corrected significance. Labels must be exchangeable within recordings. Discrimination does not establish ErrP identity.

Methods: grouped permutation testing; Monte Carlo p-values.
